reuse.why: Extends the existing isWeekendOrHoliday predicate that every holiday check in schedules and the schedules server already goes through.

duplication.why: The MM-DD matching is written once in a small isHoliday helper; nothing is copied.

placement.why: Lives in shared/schedules.ts next to the existing holiday/weekend logic.

scope.why: A one-function change plus targeted tests.

maintainability.why: Tiny, documented helper with a single responsibility that all call sites inherit.
